name: AustralianandNewZealandStandardIndustrialClassificationANZSIC2006Revision2
title: Australian and New Zealand Standard Industrial Classification (ANZSIC), 2006 (Revision 2.0)
description: The Australian and New Zealand Standard Industrial Classification (ANZSIC) provides a basis for the standardised collection, analysis and dissemination of economic data on an industry basis for Australia and New Zealand. Full details can be found at https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/mf/1292.0. This CodeSystem resource represents the ANZSIC 2006 (Revision 2.0) release of the standard. The structure of the classification is represented through hierarchy.
